name: Subtitles
description: Generate subtitles from speech using Whisper AI
longDescription:
Transcribes the spoken audio with the Whisper speech-recognition model and writes it out as a subtitle track alongside the video.

Use it to caption footage that has no subtitles of its own — home video, interviews, lectures. Larger models are more accurate but considerably slower, and accuracy falls away with heavy background noise or overlapping speakers. This pass runs after the encode and never alters the picture.

ui.label: Model
ui.description: Small (466 MB), Medium (1.5 GB), High (1.6 GB). Larger = more accurate but slower

ui.label: Output
ui.description: SRT writes alongside video; Embed muxes into container (MKV/MP4)

ui.label: Subtitle file to burn in
ui.description: Path to an .srt or .ass file to draw into the picture. Transcribed subtitles cannot be burnt in on the same pass, because transcription runs after the encode — use this for a file you already have.
